_what: The local AI apps a prompt can be opened in (tools/open-a-prompt-in-a-local-ai-app/read-data/open-in-ai.mjs, tool:open-in-ai). One row per app; the allowlist is these rows. A row's `launch` is { kind: 'url', url } (the prompt and folder fill {prompt} and {folder}, percent-encoded, and the URL is opened with the operating system's opener) or { kind: 'argv', argv: [executable, ...arguments] } (the list is run as it is, never through a shell; {prompt} and {folder} stand for a whole argument). `installed` lists the places the app is found; none of them present means app_missing. `needs_folder` makes a folder the person names required. A new app is a new row.

words.app_missing: {label} is not installed on this Mac.
words.unknown_app: {app} is not an app this Mac opens prompts in. It opens: {known}.
words.needs_prompt: Give the prompt to open as a non-empty text.
words.prompt_long: The prompt is {length} characters, more than the {most} this Mac opens.
words.needs_folder: {label} needs a folder: name a folder that exists on this Mac.
words.bad_folder: {folder} is not a folder that exists on this Mac.
